title: Create AAP Git Project
description: Idempotently create an AAP Git project in a given organization, creating the organization if it does not exist. If the project already exists, stop and report that it exists without error.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: aap_gateway_ip
parameters.description: IP or hostname of the AAP controller API endpoint.

parameters.name: aap_username
parameters.description: Username for authenticating to the AAP controller.

parameters.name: aap_password
parameters.description: Password for the AAP controller user.

parameters.name: organization_name
parameters.description: Name of the organization in which to create the project.

parameters.name: project_name
parameters.description: Name of the project to create.

parameters.name: git_url
parameters.description: Git repository URL for the project.

parameters.name: update_revision_on_launch
parameters.description: Whether to update the revision on launch ('true' or 'false').

playbook_output.description: What the emit step's <result> block contains

fields.name: message
fields.description: Status message describing the project creation outcome.

steps.name: Prepare variables from inputs
steps.function: Copy playbook input parameters into intermediate variables for reuse throughout the playbook and convert update_revision_on_launch to a boolean.

steps.name: Look up organization
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API for an organization matching the given name.

steps.name: Does the organization exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether the organization lookup found a matching result.
steps.condition: The organization lookup returned at least one result.

steps.name: Create the organization
steps.function: Create the organization using the idempotent ansible.controller.organization module.

steps.name: Look up project
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API for a project with the given name inside the organization.

steps.name: Does the project already exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether the project lookup returned a result.
steps.condition: The project lookup returned at least one result.

steps.name: Create the project
steps.function: Create the Git project using the idempotent ansible.controller.project module.

steps.name: Set already exists message
steps.function: Build a status message indicating the project already exists.

steps.name: Set created message
steps.function: Build a status message indicating the project was created successfully.

steps.name: Emit result
steps.function: Print the Required Output Format <result> block containing the status message.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Prepare inputs and ensure the target organization exists.

phases.name: Main action
phases.description: Check for an existing project and create it if missing.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Build the final status message and emit it.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
